name: jstack-audit
description: Top-level JStack command for prompt-compiled, evidence-bound read-only repository audits.

interface.longDescription: Top-level Codex workflow for bounded repository audits across correctness, security, architecture, maintainability, performance, supply chain, tests, compatibility, data integrity, operations, and applicable launch risk. Its lightweight Adaptive Context Gate uses safe audit defaults and asks only when subject, base, profile, or focus is materially ambiguous. Safe Security Operator Stage 0 verifies authority boundaries; Repository Reconnaissance Stage 1 verifies exact Git binding, complete surface coverage, source citations, graph integrity, trust boundaries, and generated-artifact provenance; Correctness and Reliability Stage 2 verifies four correctness surfaces, invariants, reciprocal reproductions, and regression plans; Security and Threat-Modelling Stage 3 verifies static STRIDE coverage, assets, adversaries, trust boundaries, controls, reciprocal reachable attack paths, critical blockers, and pinned standards mappings against the exact revision. The read-only boundary remains unchanged.
defaultPrompt: Run a read-only evidence-bound JStack audit of this repository.
